era: 2019 lowes.com desktop: a white header with the blue Lowe's logo, the store link, 'What are you looking for today?' search, MyLowe's and cart; early 2019 a blue bar with Departments and the search field, from about September 2019 a blue top strip (store, Order Status, Lowe's Credit Cards, Weekly Ad) with Shop / Services / Savings in the white header. Arquivo.pt has no 2019 captures (only redirects), and the Wayback Machine, archive.ph and the Library of Congress archive did not load from the cloud or from Chrome, so the sources are a dated 2019 screenshot, a February 2019 forum question and a 2020 Lowe's corporate story showing the 2019 site. No 2019 search-results or product-page screenshot was found, and lowes.com blocks headless browsers on those pages; features without a 2019 source are left visible and marked unproven.
